verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a dedicated Auditor API for firms to "programmatically conduct audits in Vanta." It lists audits assigned to the firm, pulls controls and evidence, manages information requests (IRLs), and reviews the in-scope resources for each engagement. Together with the marketing claim of seamless auditor collaboration, this shows auditors work inside the platform with engagement-scoped access instead of exchanging documents. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the in-app auditor UI and its permission scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration that auditors actually replace email/PDF exchanges with it.
